verdict.rationale: Docusign ships multiple built-in AI features users can delegate tasks to: AI-Assisted Review lets users chat with an AI to flag risky language, suggest redlines, and draft new clauses (docusign-docs-20, docusign-docs-25, docusign-docs-45); CLM AI flags non-compliant clauses and drafts language (docusign-docs-16); AI-Assisted Summary/Q&A helps signers understand agreements (docusign-docs-2, docusign-docs-33); Iris AI auto-converts PDFs/templates into forms (docusign-docs-27, docusign-docs-42). These are genuine in-product AI assistants for delegating agreement-related tasks, not just automation rules.  Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of these AI features' quality (all evidence is vendor-authored docs) and no benchmark of assistant reliability from community sources.
